Manifest.Name: Precision Lab Equipment / 精密实验室设备
Manifest.Author: DeepSeek Harness Agent
Manifest.Description: 新增三件实验设备与两个化学反应：精确取液器、提纯机器（含废料输出位，可收集右旋废料）、微生物培养机（营养果养菌、糖→有机废物、无糖休眠）；淀粉酸性水解成糖；以及“更多药品”肾上腺素注射笔生产线（六步化学链、原料盒、配方纸条、蓝色注射笔）。 / Adds a Precision Liquid Extractor, a Purification Machine (with a waste output slot for dextro waste), a Microbial Cultivator fed by nutrifruit, acid-catalysed starch hydrolysis, and a six-step adrenaline injection pen production line ("More Medicines" unlock, precursor kits, recipe note).
